svg.title: Two-command CLI responsibility swimlane
svg.desc: Source-bound action and responsibility projection from the current xdesign SysML design. Native action order is expanded across Agent, StageCli and Controller lanes. Orange repeat is documented intent only.

text.tspan: WishVerifyFlow CLI swimlane · one stage iteration
Simplest flow: wish -> verify -> completed; agent work and xdesign responsibilities

g.text: Same iteration at both stages · semantic judgment by a permitted agent or human

g.data-projection-basis: native guard and ordered then-body: not observe.completed
g.title: native guard and ordered then-body: not observe.completed

g.data-projection-basis: empty conditional branch -> returnWork; control shortcut when complete
g.title: empty conditional branch -> returnWork; control shortcut when complete

g.data-projection-basis: native succession + action subsetting: collectOutputs -> record :> controller.recordActivity
g.title: native succession + action subsetting: collectOutputs -> record :> controller.recordActivity

g.data-projection-basis: native succession + action subsetting: record -> assessAndAdvance :> controller.progressWish
g.title: native succession + action subsetting: record -> assessAndAdvance :> controller.progressWish

g.data-projection-basis: check conditional completes -> returnWork; expanded controller returns control
g.title: check conditional completes -> returnWork; expanded controller returns control

g.data-projection-basis: check output binding: work, completed, assessed visit assessments
g.title: check output binding: work, completed, assessed visit assessments

g.data-projection-basis: documented intent only: repeat while work is returned; stop on completion; no native back-edge
g.title: documented intent only: repeat while work is returned; stop on completion; no native back-edge

text.tspan: Orange dashed loop: documented repeat only; no native back-edge exists in AgentStageWork.
Projection: action order and responsibility; lanes are not declared SysML allocations.
Guards come from model expressions. Internal controller calls are expanded for inspection.
Design projection. Registration and final human acceptance are outside this stage interaction.
